title: Start with a square
caption: Find a square of paper. Turn it so a corner points toward you.

title: Mark the center
caption: Crease both diagonals, opening the paper after each fold.

title: Bring in the corners
caption: Fold all four tips into the center. You'll have a smaller square.

title: Crease the walls
caption: Fold opposite edges to the center and unfold. Rotate a quarter turn and repeat.

title: Lift the sides
caption: Open two opposite corner flaps. Lift the two folded sides along their creases.

title: Tuck in the ends
caption: Pinch the corner creases inward. Bring each end flap up and tuck its tip down into the base.

title: Square the tray
caption: Press the four walls and flatten the base. Your tray is ready.
